description: This file defines the 'GeneralSettings' SwiftUI view component for the OpenClaw macOS application. It manages the user interface for various application settings, including gateway configuration, health checks, remote connection settings, and debugging tools. The file also contains logic for testing remote connections, rechecking gateway status, and revealing logs.

classes.name: GeneralSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a comprehensive settings interface for the OpenClaw application, including gateway management, health monitoring, remote connection setup, and debugging tools.

methods.name: refreshGatewayStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and updates the current gateway environment status.

methods.name: testRemote
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous test of the remote gateway connection, updating the remoteStatus accordingly.

methods.name: revealLogs
methods.description: Attempts to locate and reveal the application's log files in the file viewer; shows an alert if logs are not found.

methods.name: applyDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Sets the preferred gateway stable ID based on a discovered gateway and applies remote selection accordingly.
